messages:
marta: Quick sync: planning a short, targeted runtime change in eu-central tonight 2026-05-12 21:00 UTC. Scope: minor kernel tweak + model pin to redwood-v2-stable-2026-05. Expected customer window: ~21:00-21:40 UTC.

deploybot: Job queued: runtime-eu-central-cutover-2026-05-12. Canary: 3 nodes (~5% traffic). Rollout steps: canary -> 15% -> 45% -> 100%. Auto-rollback triggers: sustained 2m 5xx >0.9% OR p99 >= baseline*1.5 OR decode corruption >0.01%.

priya: Can we draft the three customer touchpoints: statuspage blurb, short email, and optional SMS for high-availability contacts? I'll queue the SMS list after signoff.

marta: Draft statuspage (short): "Planned maintenance (EU-Central): brief runtime update and temporary model pin on 2026-05-12 21:00 UTC. A small number of requests may see brief retries during canary. Live updates: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2891230000"

emily: Draft email subject: "Planned maintenance  EU inference runtime  May 12, 21:00 UTC"
emily: Draft email body: "We will perform a brief runtime update in EU-Central on May 12 at 21:00 UTC. The model redwood-v2-stable-2026-05 will be pinned to ensure consistent behavior during the change. Most customers will be unaffected; a small fraction may experience short retries during the canary stage. We'll post live updates here: https://status.redwood.ai/"

ana: SMS (for HA contacts) suggestion: "Redwood: Brief EU runtime maintenance May 12 21:00 UTC. Some requests may retry briefly. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2891230000"

ops_sre: Ops preflight checklist: 1) health checks on canary nodes (curl /health -> 200) 2) run long-prompt smoke suite 3) snapshot KV caches and checkpoint routing tables 4) ensure fallback model redwood-v2-stable-fallback is available 5) open latency and error dashboards. Abort/rollback thresholds repeated above.

priya: Internal rollback playbook (short):
priya: ```When threshold hit: 1) Pause rollout immediately (set new job allocation to 0%) 2) Re-pin traffic to redwood-v2-stable-prev 3) Post immediate update to status + ping support escalation list 4) If affected traffic > 7%, open incident channel and escalate to SRE lead 5) Collect sample offending requests and attach to the incident for model team triage```

marta: Add Dedicated/private note to customer message: "Dedicated / private pools will only be changed if your account team confirmed scheduling."

emily: I'll schedule statuspage publish 20m before start and send email to low-priority recipients 15m prior. SMS will only go to customers signed up for HA alerts.

support-bot: Reminder scheduled: publish status at 2026-05-12T20:40:00Z and send email at 2026-05-12T20:45:00Z

deploybot: Canary started. Canary pulse (3m): 5xx 0.06%, p99 +6%. No rollback. Proceeding to 15% in 5m.

ops_sre: Observing one canary host with high cpu steal on host-level; excluding from next tranche. No customer errors reported.

marta: Exclude and continue. No change to customer messaging.

deploybot: 15% complete. Holding for 10m. Metrics: 5xx 0.08%, p99 +9%.

priya: Support FAQ short answers: "Why was my model pinned?" -> "Temporary pin ensures stable behavior while kernel changes are applied. Pin will be reverted if no issues." "Will Dedicated be impacted?" -> "Only if your account team approved it; otherwise unaffected."

emily: Statuspage live: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2891230000  published 2026-05-12T20:40:00Z

support-bot: Email queued to low-priority list (send 2026-05-12T20:45:00Z)

marta: Moving to 45% rollout. Ops watch p99 and 5xx closely for 10m.

deploybot: 45% complete. Metrics stable: 5xx 0.07%, p99 +10%. No rollback.

ops_sre: All green. Proceed to 100%.

deploybot: 100% rollout finished at 21:28 UTC. No rollback triggered.

emily: Final status update: maintenance complete, no widespread customer impact. We'll unpin redwood-v2-stable-2026-05 based on model team guidance in next scheduled window.

support-bot: Incident resolved: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2891230000  resolved at 2026-05-12T21:32:00Z"
